name: grpc-encoder
description: A zero-dependency gRPC length-prefixed framing serializer and deserializer. Formats messages into the gRPC protocol wire format (1-byte compressed flag, 4-byte big-endian length, and body), and parses incoming frames back into messages.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to serialize and deserialize binary payloads into gRPC length-prefixed frames for HTTP2 streams.
